purpose: Task-specific structural and experimentally measured kinetic constraints for selective RNA-protein assembly operations.

sources.title: Anti-sense oligonucleotide probing as a structural platform for studying ribonucleoprotein complex assembly
sources.retrieval: TinyFish full primary text; web indexed primary text turn266search0
governing_constraints: The inhibited RA20-B-c state uses protein-mediated anchors involving H98/uL13, H50/uL22, and H51/uL23/uL29/H9.
Prehybridized RNA antidotes were added before iSAT. This is not release from an existing protein-containing intermediate.
Reference contact graph excludes both misdocked RA20-B-c classes.
The experimental platform supplies S150 extract and native-derived ribosomal proteins.
supplement_constraints: Supplementary8 interprets H98/uL13 as potentially useful transient positioning, later replaced by H97/uL13.
Supplementary12 measures RA09 analog melting at3uM in iSATbuffer; do not apply its thermodynamics toRA20.
L4D9 is an assayed13-residueRA20analog; exact sequence not recovered.

governing_constraints: Native quartet contains G9,A10,U2629,A2800; H1 pairs1-8 with2895-2904.
H98 tags can leave ordinary translation intact but reduce thermal stability.
Additional adenosine restores native-like quartet and thermal resistance; construct lifetime matters separately from initial activity.

sources.title: Transient protein-RNA interactions guide nascent ribosomal RNA folding
sources.retrieval: TinyFish full primary text; web turn285search0
governing_constraints: Actual ZMW/FRET observes nascent3prime-domain folding and protein binding, rather than static occupancy alone.
H28 formation is necessary but insufficient for S7 binding.
Secondary proteins chaperone H28 formation; higherS7concentration alone does not reproduce this.
Reported pre-S7 secondary-protein dwell below100ms is an inference from detection limits, not an observed precise lifetime.
S3 incorporation reports domain assembly; full translation still requires a separate functional assay.

sources.title: Assembly of the bacterial ribosome with circularly permuted rRNA
governing_constraints: Circular permutation changes actual transcript availability order, yet reconstructed intermediates largely follow native docking hierarchy.
Reporter delay cannot by itself separate assembly delay from reduced translation function.
Flexible or small alternative structures may evade cryoEM, so the observed hierarchy is not a proof of a unique kinetic path.
